result.title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
result.summary: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Déjà-Events：仅用事件相机多视图，在单次前向中预测深度、位姿与 pointmap；通过让事件学生复现冻结 RGB 教师（Déjà View）的最终 token 做蒸馏，仅训练约 1% 参数，并引入按事件密度逐 patch 调整的自适应门控，使增加迭代细化步数时精度不降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重复共享 transformer 块细化 token + 按输入密度逐 patch 门控 + 以教师末层 token 作监督」可能为 LVR 的潜状态更新、证据稀疏时的动态计算与 latent 轨迹监督提供可核查线索，但属 3D 几何任务，迁移性需自行判断。
